summary: Old Second Bancorp Inc filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to announce the upcoming release of its second-quarter 2026 financial results after market close on July 22, 2026, and an earnings call scheduled for July 23, 2026. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine notification of an earnings release and conference call, representing an ordinary operational event rather than a special situation.
